Ana: Quick pass on release notes + internal blast. Target rollout Thu 03/26 17:00 UTC (canary -> ramp). DeployBot scheduled to start at 17:00 UTC for the staging->prod job. Change window 17:00-19:00 UTC.

Ana: Release notes draft below — feel free to paste edits.

Ana: ```
What's new
- ~18% token latency improvement for GPT-medium family under typical loads
- Model routing fallback: auto-fallback to quantized variant when memory pressure detected
- New token-cost dashboard (beta) in Console

Known issues
- Edge case: streaming truncation on long multi-turn sessions (workaround: set max_tokens to 1024 or use streaming_mode=chunked)

Rollout plan
- 17:00 UTC: DeployBot canary 10% for 30m
- 17:30 UTC: evaluate error/latency metrics; if OK, ramp to 100% over 30m
- Rollback: manual rollback to v2.3.7 via DeployBot command `deploybot rollback --release-id <id>`
```

Ben: LGTM. Reword Known issues line to be more actionable. Suggest: "If you see truncated streams, toggle streaming_mode=chunked as workaround." :thumbsup:

Claire: Locales ok, I'll add short L10N snippet for FR/DE by EOD.

Product Ops: Can we tighten the internal blast? I can do a short TL;DR for execs + engineer checklist.

SRE Oncall: What's the abort criteria for canary? Need thresholds. I propose: P50 latency + error rate. If p50 > baseline + 15% OR error rate > 0.5% absolute increase at canary -> abort and rollback.

Ana: Good call. Update plan: abort if (p50 > baseline *1.15) OR (5xx rate delta > 0.5%). Will add thresholds to the RN draft.

DeployBot: scheduled: 2026-03-26T17:00:00Z -> job id r-20260326-17-0c9. Canary 10% for 30m, auto-ramp disabled. To rollback run: `/deploybot rollback r-20260326-17-0c9`.

Ben: One more nit — change "quantized variant" -> "q4_v2 (quantized)" so customers know label.

Ana: Done. Updated draft and internal blast copy in GDoc: https://redwood.app/docs/rn/draft-123 (please don't share externally).

Claire: FR/DE snippets pushed to the doc. :white_check_mark:

Product Ops: I'll post internal blast at T-60m to #all-hands and send short email to partners. Can someone sign off on the exec bullet?

Ben: Exec bullet: "Operational improvements reduce per-token latency and give more predictable serving economics" — ok to ship.

SRE Oncall: I'll be watching metrics during canary. Oncall handoff done with @SRE Oncall2 at 19:00 UTC.

Ana: Thanks all — if no blockers, I'll merge release notes and schedule the DeployBot job. :shipit:

Claire: small ask — include a note for support about the streaming workaround so they can triage quickly.

Ana: Added a Support section in the doc with one-liners and the rollback command.

DeployBot: heartbeat will post in #release-status at canary start and ramp decisions. Good luck! :rocket:
